summary: Test specification and unit tests for EE-07 (Parallel Gateway join) created and validated.

test_cases_covered.description: Normal 2-branch join: both tokens arrive → join fires, 1 outgoing token (deterministic merged branch_id)
Cancelled-branch exclusion: 1 of 2 branches cancelled, remaining arrives → join fires (threshold=1)
All branches cancelled → INSTANCE_CANCELLED event, instance CANCELLED status, tokens cleared
Exactly-once: both tokens present (arrival order reversed) → exactly 1 merged token, 1 PARALLEL_JOIN event
3-branch join: all 3 active branches arrive via sequential task_completed events → join fires once, 1 outgoing token on t4 with branch_id of edge_index 0

notes: TC-EE-07-01 through TC-EE-07-04 are private-function tests embedded in transition.zig. They cannot be called from an external file because processNodeEntry is not exported (fn, not pub fn).
TC-EE-07-05 uses the public transition() API and exercises the 3-branch join through 3 sequential task_completed events, verifying intermediate wait states and final fire state.

The 'exactly-once' unit-level property is verified by TC-EE-07-04: both tokens already present on join_gw → processNodeEntry produces exactly 1 merged token and 1 PARALLEL_JOIN event. The full exactly-once guarantee under concurrent workload is enforced by DB-03 SELECT FOR UPDATE (integration layer).
zig build test exits 0: all existing tests continue to pass; no regressions introduced.
